metadata.desc: Adds Z-Library book search and download to AstrBot (account pool, HTML card results, quota control).

accounts.description: Z-Library account pool (add multiple accounts; downloads automatically rotate to the account with the most remaining quota)
accounts.hint: Each account has its own daily download quota (about 10 per day on a free account); more accounts raise the total daily download count. The remix credential method (last two fields) is recommended, as it is almost unaffected by Z-Library login risk control.

account.name: Account
account.hint: Add multiple accounts to share the daily download quota (about 10 per day per free account)

email.hint: Fill in together with the password; after a successful login the plugin automatically exchanges it for remix credentials. Note: the login endpoint is easily flagged by Z-Library risk control for shared IPs (#ipd3). If you keep getting rate-limited, switch to the remix method below.

password.hint: Z-Library account password, paired with the email

remix_userid.hint: How to get it: log in to z-library.sk in a browser, press F12 → Application → Storage/Cookies → copy the value of remix_userid. Fill it in together with remix_userkey; the plugin verifies via GET profile and is not affected by risk control on the login endpoint.

remix_userkey.hint: Same as above — the remix_userkey from the Cookie (a long alphanumeric string); it stays valid for a long time. If both methods are filled in, remix takes priority.

domain.description: Z-Library E-API domain or full URL
domain.hint: Enter a plain domain, a full https:// URL, or http://...onion; do not include the /eapi path. Onion mode also requires a Tor SOCKS proxy

proxy.hint: For plain domains use http://IP:port; onion requires Tor SOCKS, usually socks5://tor:9050 in Docker Compose. A plain HTTP/SOCKS proxy cannot replace Tor

max_download_mb.hint: Prevents abnormal responses from exhausting AstrBot memory; valid range 1-512 MiB

search_limit.hint: The default used when the LLM does not specify a count. Range 1-8 (values above 8 are clamped to prevent oversized card images)
